description: Schedule and manage social media posts with Pallyy. Plan content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, X and Google Business Profile: create draft or scheduled posts across several networks in one go, update captions, media and publish times, upload or import images and videos to your media library, add calendar notes, and check what's connected and what's scheduled.

defaultPrompt: Show me what's scheduled to post this week across my social accounts
Schedule an Instagram and LinkedIn post for tomorrow at 9am announcing our new feature
Import this image into my media library and draft a caption idea for it as a note
